meta.style: Hyperreal Glassmorphism, NO ring, floating 3D glass sculpture

base_prompt: Photorealistic 4K product render of a single floating glass sculpture against completely transparent background, PNG alpha, no ring, no frame, no border, no surface, no shadow — ONLY the symbol. MATERIAL: BOROFLOAT 33, IOR 1.52, white-silver monochrome. RENDER: 512spp, 12 bounces, no bloom. Key light 5600K at 2 o'clock 45-deg elevation, fill 4200K at 8 o'clock 12%.

Each tile 18x18x3.2mm, acid-etched 55% frost faces, 0.4mm chamfered fire-polished edges creating specular wireframe outlines. Top-left 60% frost, bottom-left has bisecting ridge. Assembly tilted 14deg Y, 6deg X showing depth. Caustic spots through gaps.
